description: Default capability set for the Bifrost main window. Bifrost keeps the JS-side surface minimal: file I/O, process spawning, and Sandboxie / browser orchestration happen in Rust commands. The only JS-callable surfaces granted are `shell:allow-open` (so external URLs like GitHub release pages can open in the host browser) and `core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom` (so the Settings UI-scale presets can call `webview.setZoom()`). Everything else routes through our own tauri::commands which have their own validation.
